documents.title: Growth Weekly Meeting Notes
documents.content:
# Growth Weekly Meeting

Attendees: Product, Marketing, Data.

Decision: Approved the new onboarding experiment for 20% of traffic.

Metric: activation rate increased from 32% to 35%.

Action: Data team should validate cohort split by 2026-05-10. Owner: Data team. Due: 2026-05-10.

Open question: Should enterprise accounts be excluded from the first rollout?

documents.title: Payment API Incident Log
documents.content: 2026-05-07 09:15 KST: Payment API error rate reached 2.4%. Incident severity P1. Risk: checkout conversion may drop while retries continue. Action: Backend team should inspect the latest deployment diff. Owner: Backend. Due: today. 2026-05-07 09:40 KST: rollback completed and error rate returned to 0.2%.

documents.title: Expense Policy Update
documents.content: Policy update: International travel expenses above USD 1,000 require finance approval before booking. Receipts must be submitted within 14 days. Risk: late submissions can delay reimbursement. Action: Managers should notify teams before the next travel cycle.
